verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל־ יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh bə·‘ar·ḇōṯ mō·w·’āḇ ‘al- yar·dên yə·rê·ḥōw lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho . . .
verses.literalPt: E FALOU o SENHOR a Moisés nas campinas de Moabe, junto ao Jordão na direção de Jericó, dizendo:

verses.original: צַו֮ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְנָתְנ֣וּ לַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִֽנַּחֲלַ֛ת אֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם עָרִ֣ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרָ֗שׁ לֶֽעָרִים֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṣaw ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·nā·ṯə·nū lal·wî·yim min·na·ḥă·laṯ ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯām ‘ā·rîm lā·šā·ḇeṯ ū·miḡ·rāš le·‘ā·rîm sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯê·hem tit·tə·nū lal·wî·yim
verses.literal: Command the Israelites . . . to give from the inheritance they will possess cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around . . . . . . the cities
verses.literalPt: Dá ordem aos filhos de Israel que, da herança da sua possessão, dêem cidades aos levitas, em que habitem; e também aos levitas dareis arrabaldes ao redor delas.

verses.original: וְהָי֧וּ הֶֽעָרִ֛ים לָהֶ֖ם לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֗ם יִהְי֤וּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם֙ וְלִרְכֻשָׁ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל חַיָּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū he·‘ā·rîm lā·hem lā·šā·ḇeṯ ū·miḡ·rə·šê·hem yih·yū liḇ·hem·tām wə·lir·ḵu·šām ū·lə·ḵōl ḥay·yā·ṯām
verses.literal: The cities will be for them to live in and the pasturelands will be for their herds their flocks and all their other livestock
verses.literalPt: E terão estas cidades para habitá-las; porém os seus arrabaldes serão para o seu gado, e para os seus bens, e para todos os seus animais.

verses.original: וּמִגְרְשֵׁי֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַלְוִיִּ֑ם מִקִּ֤יר הָעִיר֙ וָח֔וּצָה אֶ֥לֶף אַמָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miḡ·rə·šê he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū lal·wî·yim miq·qîr hā·‘îr wā·ḥū·ṣāh ’e·lep̄ ’am·māh sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side
verses.literalPt: E os arrabaldes das cidades, que dareis aos levitas, desde o muro da cidade para fora, serão de mil côvados em redor.

verses.original: וּמַדֹּתֶ֞ם מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֗יר אֶת־ פְּאַת־ קֵ֣דְמָה אַלְפַּ֪יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֟ה וְאֶת־ פְּאַת־ נֶגֶב֩ אַלְפַּ֨יִם בָּאַמָּ֜ה וְאֶת־ פְּאַת־ יָ֣ם׀ אַלְפַּ֣יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֗ה וְאֵ֨ת פְּאַ֥ת צָפ֛וֹן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בָּאַמָּ֖ה וְהָעִ֣יר בַּתָּ֑וֶךְ זֶ֚ה יִהְיֶ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם מִגְרְשֵׁ֖י הֶעָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mad·dō·ṯem mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr ’eṯ- pə·’aṯ- qê·ḏə·māh ’al·pa·yim bā·’am·māh wə·’eṯ- pə·’aṯ- ne·ḡeḇ ’al·pa·yim bā·’am·māh wə·’eṯ- pə·’aṯ- yām ’al·pa·yim bā·’am·māh wə·’êṯ pə·’aṯ ṣā·p̄ō·wn ’al·pa·yim bā·’am·māh wə·hā·‘îr bat·tā·weḵ zeh yih·yeh lā·hem miḡ·rə·šê he·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east two thousand on the south two thousand on the west and two thousand on the north with the city in the center These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities
verses.literalPt: E de fora da cidade, do lado do oriente, medireis dois mil côvados, e do lado do sul, dois mil côvados, e do lado do ocidente dois mil côvados, e do lado do norte dois mil côvados, e a cidade no meio; isto terão por arrabaldes das cidades.

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת הֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֵ֚ת שֵׁשׁ־ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתְּנ֔וּ לָנֻ֥ס שָׁ֖מָּה הָרֹצֵ֑חַ וַעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם תִּתְּנ֔וּ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם עִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū lal·wî·yim ’êṯ šêš- ‘ā·rê ham·miq·lāṭ ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū lā·nus šām·māh hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ wa·‘ă·lê·hem tit·tə·nū ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·ta·yim ‘îr
verses.literal: Six of the cities you give the Levites - are to be appointed as cities of refuge to which a manslayer may flee In addition to these give the Levites forty-two . . . other cities
verses.literalPt: Das cidades, pois, que dareis aos levitas, haverá seis cidades de refúgio, as quais dareis para que o homicida ali se acolha; e, além destas, lhes dareis quarenta e duas cidades.

verses.original: כָּל־ הֶעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה עִ֑יר אֶתְהֶ֖ן וְאֶת־ מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū lal·wî·yim ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·mō·neh ‘îr ’eṯ·hen wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rə·šê·hen
verses.literal: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight . . . . . . with their corresponding pasturelands
verses.literalPt: Todas as cidades que dareis aos levitas serão quarenta e oito cidades, juntamente com os seus arrabaldes.

verses.original: וְהֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵאֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֵ֤ת הָרַב֙ תַּרְבּ֔וּ וּמֵאֵ֥ת הַמְעַ֖ט תַּמְעִ֑יטוּ אִ֗ישׁ כְּפִ֤י נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִנְחָ֔לוּ יִתֵּ֥ן מֵעָרָ֖יו לַלְוִיִּֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū mê·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’êṯ hā·raḇ tar·bū ū·mê·’êṯ ham·‘aṭ tam·‘î·ṭū ’îš kə·p̄î na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw ’ă·šer yin·ḥā·lū yit·tên mê·‘ā·rāw lal·wî·yim
verses.literal: The cities that you apportion . . . from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance - of each tribe . . . more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one
verses.literalPt: E quanto às cidades que derdes da herança dos filhos de Israel, do que tiver muito tomareis muito, e do que tiver pouco tomareis pouco; cada um dará das suas cidades aos levitas, segundo a herança que herdar.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kî ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên ’ar·ṣāh kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them . . . When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando passardes o Jordão à terra de Canaã,

verses.original: וְהִקְרִיתֶ֤ם לָכֶם֙ עָרִ֔ים עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לָכֶ֑ם וְנָ֥ס שָׁ֙מָּה֙ רֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rî·ṯem lā·ḵem ‘ā·rîm ‘ā·rê miq·lāṭ tih·ye·nāh lā·ḵem wə·nās šām·māh rō·ṣê·aḥ mak·kêh- ne·p̄eš biš·ḡā·ḡāh
verses.literal: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there
verses.literalPt: Fazei com que vos estejam à mão cidades que vos sirvam de cidades de refúgio, para que ali se acolha o homicida que ferir a alguma alma por engano.

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֧ם הֶעָרִ֛ים לְמִקְלָ֖ט מִגֹּאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א יָמוּת֙ הָרֹצֵ֔חַ עַד־ עָמְד֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū lā·ḵem he·‘ā·rîm lə·miq·lāṭ mig·gō·’êl wə·lō yā·mūṯ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ‘aḏ- ‘ā·mə·ḏōw lip̄·nê hā·‘ê·ḏāh lam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly
verses.literalPt: E estas cidades vos serão por refúgio do vingador do sangue; para que o homicida não morra, até que seja apresentado à congregação para julgamento.

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֵּ֑נוּ שֵׁשׁ־ עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer tit·tê·nū šêš- ‘ā·rê miq·lāṭ tih·ye·nāh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: The cities you select will be your six cities of refuge
verses.literalPt: E das cidades que derdes haverá seis cidades de refúgio para vós.

verses.original: אֵ֣ת׀ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶעָרִ֗ים תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵעֵ֣בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְאֵת֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים תִּתְּנ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ šə·lōš he·‘ā·rîm tit·tə·nū mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên wə·’êṯ šə·lōš he·‘ā·rîm tit·tə·nū bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an ‘ā·rê miq·lāṭ tih·ye·nāh
verses.literal: Select three cities . . . across the Jordan and three - in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge
verses.literalPt: Três destas cidades dareis além do Jordão, e três destas cidades dareis na terra de Canaã; cidades de refúgio serão.

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּ֤ר וְלַתּוֹשָׁב֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔ם תִּהְיֶ֛ינָה שֵׁשׁ־ הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לְמִקְלָ֑ט לָנ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּה כָּל־ מַכֵּה־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lag·gêr wə·lat·tō·wō·šāḇ bə·ṯō·w·ḵām tih·ye·nāh šêš- he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh lə·miq·lāṭ lā·nūs šām·māh kāl- mak·kêh- ne·p̄eš biš·ḡā·ḡāh
verses.literal: These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites . . . and for the foreigner or stranger among them so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there
verses.literalPt: Serão por refúgio estas seis cidades para os filhos de Israel, e para o estrangeiro, e para o que se hospedar no meio deles, para que ali se acolha aquele que matar a alguém por engano.

verses.original: וְאִם־ בִּכְלִ֨י בַרְזֶ֧ל׀ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָרֹצֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- biḵ·lî ḇar·zel hik·kā·hū way·yā·mōṯ rō·ṣê·aḥ hū mō·wṯ yū·maṯ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ
verses.literal: If, however anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him he is a murderer the murderer must surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém, se o ferir com instrumento de ferro e morrer, homicida é; certamente o homicida morrerá.

verses.original: וְאִ֡ם בְּאֶ֣בֶן יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יָמ֨וּת בָּ֥הּ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָרֹצֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im bə·’e·ḇen yāḏ ’ă·šer- yā·mūṯ bāh hik·kā·hū way·yā·mōṯ rō·ṣê·aḥ hū mō·wṯ yū·maṯ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ
verses.literal: Or if anyone has in his hand a stone of deadly size and he strikes and kills another he is a murderer the murderer must surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: Ou, se lhe ferir com uma pedrada, de que possa morrer, e morrer, homicida é; certamente o homicida morrerá.

verses.original: א֡וֹ בִּכְלִ֣י עֵֽץ־ יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יָמ֨וּת בּ֥וֹ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָרֹצֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw biḵ·lî ‘êṣ- yāḏ ’ă·šer- yā·mūṯ bōw hik·kā·hū way·yā·mōṯ rō·ṣê·aḥ hū mō·wṯ yū·maṯ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ
verses.literal: If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood and he strikes and kills another he is a murderer the murderer . . . must surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: Ou, se o ferir com instrumento de pau que tiver na mão, de que possa morrer, e ele morrer, homicida é; certamente morrerá o homicida.

verses.original: גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יָמִ֖ית אֶת־ הָרֹצֵ֑חַ בְּפִגְעוֹ־ ב֖וֹ ה֥וּא יְמִיתֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: gō·’êl had·dām hū yā·mîṯ ’eṯ- hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ bə·p̄iḡ·‘ōw- ḇōw hū yə·mî·ṯen·nū
verses.literal: The avenger of blood - is to put the murderer to death when he finds him he is to kill him
verses.literalPt: O vingador do sangue matará o homicida; encontrando-o, matá-lo-á.

verses.original: וְאִם־ בְּשִׂנְאָ֖ה יֶהְדָּפֶ֑נּוּ אֽוֹ־ הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛יו בִּצְדִיָּ֖ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bə·śin·’āh yeh·dā·p̄en·nū ’ōw- hiš·lîḵ ‘ā·lāw biṣ·ḏî·yāh way·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him
verses.literalPt: Se também o empurrar com ódio, ou com mal intento lançar contra ele alguma coisa, e morrer;

verses.original: א֣וֹ בְאֵיבָ֞ה הִכָּ֤הוּ בְיָדוֹ֙ וַיָּמֹ֔ת מֽוֹת־ יוּמַ֥ת הַמַּכֶּ֖ה רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֗ם יָמִ֛ית אֶת־ הָרֹצֵ֖חַ בְּפִגְעוֹ־ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ḇə·’ê·ḇāh hik·kā·hū ḇə·yā·ḏōw way·yā·mōṯ mō·wṯ- yū·maṯ ham·mak·keh rō·ṣê·aḥ hū gō·’êl had·dām yā·mîṯ ’eṯ- hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ bə·p̄iḡ·‘ōw- ḇōw
verses.literal: or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies the one who struck him must surely be put to death . . . he is a murderer When the avenger of blood finds the murderer he is to kill him
verses.literalPt: Ou por inimizade o ferir com a sua mão, e morrer, certamente morrerá aquele que o ferir; homicida é; o vingador do sangue, encontrando o homicida, o matará.

verses.original: וְאִם־ בְּפֶ֥תַע בְּלֹא־ אֵיבָ֖ה הֲדָפ֑וֹ אוֹ־ הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛יו כָּל־ כְּלִ֖י בְּלֹ֥א צְדִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bə·p̄e·ṯa‘ bə·lō- ’ê·ḇāh hă·ḏā·p̄ōw ’ōw- hiš·lîḵ ‘ā·lāw kāl- kə·lî bə·lō ṣə·ḏî·yāh
verses.literal: But if anyone pushes a person suddenly without hostility or throws an object at him unintentionally . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém, se o empurrar subitamente, sem inimizade, ou contra ele lançar algum instrumento sem intenção;

verses.original: א֣וֹ בְכָל־ אֶ֜בֶן אֲשֶׁר־ יָמ֥וּת בָּהּ֙ בְּלֹ֣א רְא֔וֹת וַיַּפֵּ֥ל עָלָ֖יו וַיָּמֹ֑ת וְהוּא֙ לֹא־ אוֹיֵ֣ב ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ רָעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ḇə·ḵāl- ’e·ḇen ’ă·šer- yā·mūṯ bāh bə·lō rə·’ō·wṯ way·yap·pêl ‘ā·lāw way·yā·mōṯ wə·hū lō- ’ō·w·yêḇ lōw wə·lō mə·ḇaq·qêš rā·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: or . . . without looking drops . . . a heavy stone that kills him but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him
verses.literalPt: Ou, sobre ele deixar cair alguma pedra sem o ver, de que possa morrer, e ele morrer, sem que fosse seu inimigo nem procurasse o seu mal;

verses.original: וְשָֽׁפְטוּ֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין הַמַּכֶּ֔ה וּבֵ֖ין גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֑ם עַ֥ל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·p̄ə·ṭū hā·‘ê·ḏāh bên ham·mak·keh ū·ḇên gō·’êl had·dām ‘al ham·miš·pā·ṭîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: then the congregation must judge between the slayer . . . and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances
verses.literalPt: Então a congregação julgará entre aquele que feriu e o vingador do sangue, segundo estas leis.

verses.original: וְהִצִּ֨ילוּ הָעֵדָ֜ה אֶת־ הָרֹצֵ֗חַ מִיַּד֮ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּם֒ וְהֵשִׁ֤יבוּ אֹתוֹ֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה אֶל־ עִ֥יר מִקְלָט֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ נָ֣ס שָׁ֑מָּה וְיָ֣שַׁב בָּ֗הּ עַד־ מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ מָשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṣ·ṣî·lū hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’eṯ- hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ mî·yaḏ gō·’êl had·dām wə·hê·šî·ḇū ’ō·ṯōw hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’el- ‘îr miq·lā·ṭōw ’ă·šer- nās šām·māh wə·yā·šaḇ bāh ‘aḏ- mō·wṯ hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏōl ’ă·šer- mā·šaḥ ’ō·ṯōw bə·še·men haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled . . . and he must live there until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil
verses.literalPt: E a congregação livrará o homicida da mão do vingador do sangue, e a congregação o fará voltar à cidade do seu refúgio, onde se tinha acolhido; e ali ficará até à morte do sumo sacerdote, a quem ungiram com o santo óleo.

verses.original: וְאִם־ יָצֹ֥א יֵצֵ֖א הָרֹצֵ֑חַ אֶת־ גְּבוּל֙ עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנ֖וּס שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yā·ṣō yê·ṣê hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ’eṯ- gə·ḇūl ‘îr miq·lā·ṭōw ’ă·šer yā·nūs šām·māh
verses.literal: But if the manslayer ever goes outside . . . the limits of the city of refuge to which he fled . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém, se de alguma maneira o homicida sair dos limites da cidade de refúgio, onde se tinha acolhido,

verses.original: וּמָצָ֤א אֹתוֹ֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם מִח֕וּץ לִגְב֖וּל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑וֹ וְרָצַ֞ח גֹּאֵ֤ל הַדָּם֙ אֶת־ הָ֣רֹצֵ֔חַ אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·ṣā ’ō·ṯōw gō·’êl had·dām mi·ḥūṣ liḡ·ḇūl ‘îr miq·lā·ṭōw wə·rā·ṣaḥ gō·’êl had·dām ’eṯ- hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ’ên lōw dām
verses.literal: and the avenger of blood finds him outside . . . of his city of refuge and kills him then the avenger will not be guilty of bloodshed
verses.literalPt: E o vingador do sangue o achar fora dos limites da cidade de seu refúgio, e o matar, não será culpado do sangue.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְעִ֤יר מִקְלָטוֹ֙ יֵשֵׁ֔ב עַד־ מ֖וֹת הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֑ל וְאַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֔ל יָשׁוּב֙ הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶל־ אֶ֖רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·‘îr miq·lā·ṭōw yê·šêḇ ‘aḏ- mō·wṯ hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏōl wə·’a·ḥă·rê mō·wṯ hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏōl yā·šūḇ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ’el- ’e·reṣ ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw
verses.literal: because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns
verses.literalPt: Pois o homicida deverá ficar na cidade do seu refúgio, até à morte do sumo sacerdote; mas, depois da morte do sumo sacerdote, o homicida voltará à terra da sua possessão.

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ אֵ֧לֶּה לָכֶ֛ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּ֖ט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ’êl·leh lā·ḵem lə·ḥuq·qaṯ miš·pāṭ lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵōl mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come wherever you live
verses.literalPt: E estas coisas vos serão por estatuto de direito às vossas gerações, em todas as vossas habitações.

verses.original: כָּל־ מַ֨כֵּה־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְפִ֣י עֵדִ֔ים יִרְצַ֖ח אֶת־ הָרֹצֵ֑חַ וְעֵ֣ד אֶחָ֔ד לֹא־ יַעֲנֶ֥ה בְנֶ֖פֶשׁ לָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mak·kêh- ne·p̄eš lə·p̄î ‘ê·ḏîm yir·ṣaḥ ’eṯ- hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ wə·‘êḏ ’e·ḥāḏ lō- ya·‘ă·neh ḇə·ne·p̄eš lā·mūṯ
verses.literal: If anyone kills a person the murderer is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness
verses.literalPt: Todo aquele que matar alguma pessoa, conforme depoimento de testemunhas, será morto; mas uma só testemunha não testemunhará contra alguém, para que morra.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תִקְח֥וּ כֹ֙פֶר֙ לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ רֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר־ ה֥וּא רָשָׁ֖ע לָמ֑וּת כִּי־ מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯiq·ḥū ḵō·p̄er lə·ne·p̄eš rō·ṣê·aḥ ’ă·šer- hū rā·šā‘ lā·mūṯ kî- mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who . . . deserves to die . . . he must surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: E não recebereis resgate pela vida do homicida que é culpado de morte; pois certamente morrerá.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ תִקְח֣וּ כֹ֔פֶר לָנ֖וּס אֶל־ עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑וֹ לָשׁוּב֙ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת בָּאָ֔רֶץ עַד־ מ֖וֹת הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯiq·ḥū ḵō·p̄er lā·nūs ’el- ‘îr miq·lā·ṭōw lā·šūḇ lā·še·ḇeṯ bā·’ā·reṣ ‘aḏ- mō·wṯ hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest
verses.literalPt: Também não tomareis resgate por aquele que se acolher à sua cidade de refúgio, para tornar a habitar na terra, até à morte do sumo sacerdote.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תַחֲנִ֣יפוּ אֶת־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בָּ֔הּ כִּ֣י הַדָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יַחֲנִ֖יף אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלָאָ֣רֶץ לֹֽא־ יְכֻפַּ֗ר לַדָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שֻׁפַּךְ־ בָּ֔הּ כִּי־ אִ֖ם בְּדַ֥ם שֹׁפְכֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯa·ḥă·nî·p̄ū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tem bāh kî had·dām hū ya·ḥă·nîp̄ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lā·’ā·reṣ lō- yə·ḵup·par lad·dām ’ă·šer šup·paḵ- bāh kî- ’im bə·ḏam šō·p̄ə·ḵōw
verses.literal: Do not pollute the land where you live for bloodshed . . . pollutes the land and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood is shed except . . . by the blood of the one who shed it
verses.literalPt: Assim não profanareis a terra em que estais; porque o sangue faz profanar a terra; e nenhuma expiação se fará pela terra por causa do sangue que nela se derramar, senão com o sangue daquele que o derramou.

verses.original: וְלֹ֧א תְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ן בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁכֵ֕ן בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṯə·ṭam·mê ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tem yō·šə·ḇîm bāh ’ă·šer ’ă·nî šō·ḵên bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh šō·ḵên bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell For I the LORD dwell among the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Não contaminareis pois a terra na qual vós habitais, no meio da qual eu habito; pois eu, o SENHOR, habito no meio dos filhos de Israel.
